green_expectations: Use the packaged inspect, upgrade, doctor, reconcile, and recover operations.
Block dirty overlap instead of excluding a managed destination.
Keep migration evidence inside the repository contract without copying arbitrary content.
Report version drift without mutating until explicit upgrade authority exists.
Use native task fan-in and preserve project owner's one-pinned-coordinator workflow.
Use the smallest safe orientation tier and escalate automatically on stale, conflicting, wrong-target, or unclear-risk evidence.
Keep STATUS compact and heartbeats silent when state is unchanged.
Use bounded workers for execution and long-running observation while the coordinator retains judgment and release authority; project owner retains consequential approvals.
Keep compaction enabled, but rotate oversized coordinators instead of repeatedly restoring them into polling loops.
